title: Lyn Buchanan, army psychic spy behind The Men Who Stare at Goats

tellings.quote: Cassidy is based on a guy named Lynn Buchanan who's a famous kind of army psychic spy remote viewer, and I I just interviewed him.

plain: The character Cassidy in The Men Who Stare at Goats, a story about the US Army's psychic soldiers, is based on a real man named Lyn Buchanan, a well-known army psychic spy and remote viewer, meaning someone trained to perceive distant targets using only the mind. Michels says this himself, adding that he had just interviewed Buchanan, and he names the Army figure Albert Stubblebine alongside him; if true, it means the film's oddest characters had real counterparts.
